items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...there were — people would come through like Orson Bean doing his comedy act... [INTERVIEWEE] Before anyone knew him.

ctx.x: He just had that attitude, he just had that kind of, you know, attitude.

So we auditioned, we made it, and we were put into the showroom in the back. Bart Howard was playing piano and playing all those wonderful songs of his, and there were — people would come through like Orson Bean doing his comedy act, Andy Griffith doing his comedy act.
